name: nighthawks-backend
description: PS-021 dialog correlation and recovery backend — experimental prototype

_notes.sqlite_driver: sql.js (pure WebAssembly SQLite) is the driver in use: no native compilation required. better-sqlite3 was not used because it needs a C++ build toolchain that is unavailable on the development machine. The database lives in memory and is written to the .db file after every mutation (src/db/index.ts persistToDisk).
